name: git_helper
description: Inspect a local git repository: status, commit log, branches, remotes, working-directory diff, or stash list.

action.description: status: working tree changes. log: commit history. branches: all local+remote branches. remote: remote URLs. diff: uncommitted changes. stash: stashed changes list.

repo_path.description: Path to the git repository. Defaults to the current directory if omitted.

limit.description: Number of commits to show for action='log'. Defaults to 10.
